touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Partney qualifies as a local detour through Churchyard cross, St Nicholas's churchyard and CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Partney: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Partney offers Churchyard cross, St Nicholas's churchyard, CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS, REMAINS OF CROSS IN CHURCHYARD OF ST NICHOLAS, 10 METRES SOUTH OF THE CHANCEL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Churchyard cross, St Nicholas's churchyard
